title: Oil Prices Today: Brent Slips Below $92 As Supply Glut Deepens, But Middle East Attacks Keep Bulls From Giving Up
text: Data from the US Energy Information Administration (EIA) showed that crude inventories rose by 3.38 million barrels to 417.8 million barrels in the week ended November 13. This was considerablyhigher than analysts' expectations of an increase of 58,000 barrels in a Reuters poll.

title: Scene Box Office Collection Day 13: Suriya's Film Maintains Steady Run, But Collections Dip
text: 'Scene' earned Rs 1 crore from overseas markets on Day 13, taking its overseas gross collection to Rs 88 crore. Its worldwide gross collection has now reached Rs 256.50 crore.

title: Anthropic Share Price: Claude Maker Sets $83 Price Ahead Of Nasdaq Debut
text: The shares are expected to begin trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market on November 19, 2026, under the ticker symbol 'ANT'.

title: Global Market Today: Asian shares mixed as commodity prices tumble
text: Contracts for the Nasdaq 100 Index rose 0.9% and those for the S&P 500 Index climbed 0.5%. That came after Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share, making it the biggest first-time share sale on record.

title: Rupee hits seven-month high of 93.28 against U.S. dollar, pares gains to settle flat at 93.50

title: Anthropic raised $81 billion in IPO despite $104 billion loss: Why Wall Street is betting big on Claude
text: Anthropic raised $81.3 billion in its IPO, pricing shares at $83 and selling more shares than planned. Revenue surged as Claude Code gained popularity, but the company reported a $104 billion net loss.

title: 'Let's move forward': Nvidia interim CEO Kress announces pay raises at first all-hands meeting since Huang's exit
text: Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress urged employees to move forward at the company's first all-hands meeting since Jensen Huang's resignation, announcing pay raises as calls for the former chief's return grow despite the board ruling out his reinstatement.

title: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO opens today: Should you subscribe to the ₹8,981 crore issue?

The brief exchange took place during a welcome event for visiting leaders. While the two exchanged smiles, Japan's foreign ministry described the handshake as normal diplomatic protocol. China-Japan tensions remain unresolved, with formal talks between Xi and Takaichi reportedly unlikely during the summit.
